_doc: Per-repo overrides for the merge-queue skill. Precedence: built-in defaults < "*" < "owner/*" < "owner/repo" < flags given when invoking. Any key from DEFAULTS in scripts/mq.py can be set. The base branch is always the repo's default branch and cannot be configured. Keys: author (me|all|[logins]), copilot (auto|required|off), update (merge = GitHub's Update branch default, a merge commit; the default | rebase = Update with rebase | none), method (squash|merge|rebase), exclude_labels, exclude_title_patterns, release {branches, labels, titles}, addressing_bots, wait_timeout_minutes, auto_merge (false = merge directly once green, the default; true = gh pr merge --auto), rebase_fallback (merge = when a rebase can't work, merge the base into the PR instead; only with squash merges; the default. skip = skip the PR).
